get.description: Unique users exposed per experiment and variant, from the experiment_exposures rollup. Counts raw identities (user_id, else anonymous_id) with a uniqCombined sketch (~0.8% error at scale; exact for small sets); identity-stitched exact numbers are served by the conversion and funnel endpoints. timeGrain: day, week, or month (hour is rejected; the rollup is daily); omitted = one bucket for the whole range. Re-exposures never double-count.

400.description: Malformed request or `timeGrain` or `experiment` or `to` or `from`

401.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, or revoked credential

403.description: A valid credential lacks metrics-read permission

get.description: Per-variant conversion for one experiment: exposed unique users, users with a conversion event at or after their first exposure (earlier conversions do not count), and the rate. Users exposed to multiple variants count in each. Counts and rates only; no significance testing.

400.description: Malformed request or `to` or `from` or `event` or `experiment`

401.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, or revoked credential

403.description: A valid credential lacks metrics-read permission

get.description: Ordered funnel per variant of one experiment. Users counted at step N performed steps 1..N in order, all at or after their first exposure to the experiment, within `window` seconds of the chain's first step (default: the full from/to range, capped at 90 days). Steps before first exposure do not count.

400.description: Malformed request or `window` or `to` or `from` or `steps` or `experiment`

401.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, or revoked credential

403.description: A valid credential lacks metrics-read permission
